events.title: National Presto: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
events.body: EAU CLAIRE, Wis. AP) : National Presto Industries Inc. NPK) on Friday reported net income of $15 million in its fourth quarter.

events.title: NPK's 2025 Earnings Fall Y/Y Due to Housewares Unit Weakness
events.body: National Presto's 2025 earnings are strained by weak housewares sales, supplier issues and relocation costs, but posted strong revenue growth driven by defense shipments.

events.title: Tariffs Weigh on National Presto's Q3 Earnings Despite Sales Growth
events.body: NPK's Q3 EPS fall 35% year over year as strong Defense shipments drive revenues up 26%, but tariff-related costs in the Housewares segment erode margins and weigh on overall profitability.
